    heapq.heapify(hero_capacity)
    
    # Sort the monsters in descending order
    monsters = sorted([(a, i) for i, a in enumerate(A)], reverse=True)
    
    total_defeated = 0

        if not hero_capacity:

        # Get the hero with the highest capacity

        # If the hero can still defeat more monsters, push back to heap
